title: God of Ashford
subtitle: You are the village's god. Answer prayers, send signs, make demands.
intro: Ashford keeps a temple to you, though not everyone in it believes. You have no body: only the power bar and the mana their belief gives you. Villagers come to the temple to pray (🙏 Prayers): answer with a power, a dream, or silence. 📢 Decree a demand: Ada will have a vision and the village will argue it out at a council. Answered prayers, kept prophecies and rewarded obedience raise belief; silence, cruelty for nothing and broken promises lower it. ⏸ and ×2 control time.

house_miller.name: the Millers
house_miller.description: a household: Wren and her brother Bram

house_reed.name: the Reeds
house_reed.description: a household: Tilly and her husband Finn

agents.style: stooped elder priestess with a staff
agents.personality: Ada, the village elder and priestess of the temple. The god sends you visions. You are patient with the doubters, and sure they will see.
Wren, the baker. Devout and practical. You leave a loaf at the temple when you can, and you worry about your brother Bram's loose tongue.
Tilly, the farmer. You talk to your plants and to the god in the same breath. Your husband Finn's doubts hurt you.
Bram, Wren's brother, a labourer. You believe in what you can lift. You think the temple eats bread the village needs.
Finn, Tilly's husband, a woodcutter. You have never seen the god do anything a storm could not. You would like to be proven wrong, though you would never say so.
